import { loadGates } from './scripts/load-gates.mjs'

  plugins: ['@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner'],

    related: true,

  mutate: [
    'src/**/*.ts',
    'src/**/*.tsx',
    'scripts/roadmap.mjs',
    'scripts/agent.mjs',
    'scripts/check.mjs',
    'scripts/e2e-burn-in-count.mjs',
    'scripts/e2e-burn-in-targets.mjs',
    'scripts/e2e-changed-quiet.mjs',
    'scripts/e2e-playwright-summary.mjs',
    'scripts/load-gates.mjs',
    'scripts/check-gate-values.mjs',
    'scripts/check-gate-ratchet.mjs',
    'scripts/stryker-disable-detect.mjs',
    'scripts/stryker-pr-summary.mjs',
    'scripts/stryker-diff-gate.mjs',
    'scripts/check-test-weakening.mjs',
    'scripts/check-codecov-yml.mjs',
    'scripts/e2e-flaky-list.mjs',
    '!src/**/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx}',
    '!src/**/*.{bench,benchmark}.{ts,tsx}',
    '!src/**/*.d.ts',
    '!src/**/*.test-helpers.ts',
    '!src/core/testing/**',
    '!src/main.tsx',
    '!src/photo/photo.worker.ts',
    '!src/assets/hash.worker.ts',
    '!src/project/fsa/bookLoad.worker.ts',
    '!src/project/session/idb.ts',
    '!src/project/session/locks.ts',
    '!src/editor/EditorShell.tsx',
    '!src/editor/HomeScreen.tsx',
    '!src/App.tsx',
    '!src/editor/previewAspect.ts',
    '!src/editor/upgradeSessionAssets.ts',
    '!src/editor/usePasteboardCamera.ts',
    '!src/editor/projectSession.ts',
  ],
  ignorePatterns: [
    '.local_dev',
    'dist',
    'coverage',
    'reports',
    'test-results',
    'playwright-report',
    '.lighthouseci',
    '.stryker-tmp',
    'C:*',
  ],
  reporters: ['clear-text', 'html', 'json'],
  jsonReporter: {
    fileName: 'reports/mutation/mutation.json',
  },
  coverageAnalysis: 'perTest',
  thresholds: gates.stryker.thresholds,
  ignoreStatic: true,
}

export default config
base.codecov.yml:
# Two coverage uploads per commit: unit lcov + e2e lcov.
# e2e carryforward is false so a prior commit cannot satisfy after_n_builds early.
codecov:
  notify:
    after_n_builds: 2

coverage:
  status:
    project:
      default:
        target: auto
        threshold: 0.5%
      floor:
        target: 80%
        threshold: 0%
    patch:
      default:
        target: 85%
        threshold: 0%

bundle_analysis:
  warning_threshold: '5%'
  status: informational

flag_management:
  default_rules:
    carryforward: true

comment:
  # Two uploads per commit (unit + e2e); must match notify.after_n_builds.
  after_n_builds: 2
  # flags requested; Codecov on this repo still omits the Flags table in GitHub comments
  # (same class as project/components — see docs/backlog/codecov-project-components.md).
  layout: 'header, diff, flags, files'
  behavior: default
  require_changes: false
  require_base: false

component_management:
  individual_components:
    - component_id: photo
      name: photo
      paths:
        - src/photo/**
    - component_id: perf
      name: perf
      paths:
        - src/perf/**
    - component_id: lib
      name: lib
      paths:
        - src/lib/**
    - component_id: editor
      name: editor
      paths:
        - src/editor/**
    - component_id: project
      name: project
      paths:
        - src/project/**
    - component_id: assets
      name: assets
      paths:
        - src/assets/**
    - component_id: render
      name: render
      paths:
        - src/render/**
    - component_id: core
      name: core
      paths:
        - src/core/**
    - component_id: scripts
      name: scripts
      paths:
        - scripts/**

ignore:
  - 'e2e/**'
  - 'src/**/*.{bench,benchmark}.{ts,tsx}'
  - 'src/**/*.d.ts'
  - 'src/**/*.test-helpers.ts'
  - 'src/main.tsx'

flags:
  unit:
    paths:
      - src/
      - scripts/roadmap.mjs
      - scripts/agent.mjs
      - scripts/check.mjs
      - scripts/e2e-burn-in-count.mjs
      - scripts/e2e-burn-in-targets.mjs
      - scripts/e2e-playwright-summary.mjs
      - scripts/check-gate-ratchet.mjs
      - scripts/check-test-weakening.mjs
    carryforward: true
  e2e:
    paths:
      - src/
    # Must upload on every commit; carryforward would satisfy after_n_builds early.
    carryforward: false
